title: Standard F1b Saint Berdoodles
temperament: Known for their friendly demeanor and high trainability, these Saint Berdoodles offer a wonderfully balanced temperament that brings a peaceful, happy presence to any home.
cardDesc: Meet our stunning Standard F1b Saint Berdoodles from Nina and Thomas, known for their calm demeanor, easygoing temperaments, and wavy, hypoallergenic coats. Highly affectionate and eager to please, these sweet-tempered pups make the perfect loving playmates for the entire family.
